items.chunk: I have a feeling I know what this is about.
items.meaning: 我觉得我知道这是怎么回事；谨慎猜测
items.quote: I have a feeling I know what this is about.

items.meaning: 过去的事、不必再计较
items.quote: I'm hoping it's just water under the bridge.

items.chunk: after all is said and done
items.meaning: 归根到底／到头来
items.quote: Because after all was said and done, you did walk out a free man.

items.meaning: 本身足以说明问题，无须多说
items.quote: So I'm hoping that, in the end, you know, the final result speaks for itself.

items.meaning: 家人之间相像的地方
items.quote: And I see the family resemblance.

items.meaning: 给人留下很深的印象
items.quote: Your cousin makes quite an impression.

items.meaning: 脾气暴躁
items.quote: He's got a temper, huh?

items.meaning: 狠狠惩罚某人；此处是暴力威胁性夸张
items.quote: he would've skinned them alive and let the buzzards eat their eyeballs.

items.meaning: 刚才一小会儿；回顾短暂误以为
items.quote: It's just that, for a minute there, I thought I was gonna be swallowing condoms filled with heroin.

items.meaning: 待会儿会谈到那个；暂缓说明
items.quote: - Picked up for what? - Yeah, we'll get to that.

items.meaning: 不多也不少，恰好如此
items.quote: No more, no less.

items.meaning: 律师与委托人的保密关系
items.quote: Attorney-client confidentiality.

items.meaning: 承蒙看得起；回应对方称赞／委托
items.quote: Uh, that's flattering.

items.meaning: 省去中间人，直接联系
items.quote: Anyway, you talk directly to your guy, cut out the middleman.

items.meaning: 算算就知道了；让对方自行推算
items.quote: Do the math,

items.meaning: 当前通行的价格／行情
items.quote: It's the going rate, so...

items.meaning: 今天就到这儿／今晚收工
items.quote: I don't know, Mike. How about you call it a night?

items.meaning: 把悬挂的东西取下来；此处指照片
items.quote: Take it down.

items.meaning: 你喝得够多了；劝停止饮酒
items.quote: I think you've had enough.

items.meaning: 我又不会咬你；让人别怕，ain't属非正式非标准形式
items.quote: I ain't gonna bite.

items.meaning: 动手打架；此处美式俚语
items.quote: Hey, yo, gramps can throw down, okay.

items.meaning: 起起落落、顺境和逆境
items.quote: Ups and downs.

items.meaning: 从经济／收入方面来说
items.quote: Financially speaking, Saul Goodman just had his best day yet.

items.meaning: 去好好干吧／加油；亲昵鼓励
items.quote: Right. Go get them, tiger.

items.meaning: 把东西拆开
items.quote: I have to take it apart to clean it.

items.meaning: 别告诉我……；猜到坏事后的反应
items.quote: Don't tell me.

items.meaning: 保持原样
items.quote: He wants to keep it as is.

items.meaning: 这是你安排的，对吧？；追问幕后责任
items.quote: This is you, isn't it?

items.meaning: 你说我说错了啊；要求否认、常带质问
items.quote: Tell me I'm wrong.

items.meaning: 放弃／停止某事；此处退出犯罪
items.quote: Give this up.

items.meaning: 本来不想打扰你，可是……
items.quote: - I wouldn't bother you, but... - I asked you to handle it.

items.meaning: 现在不是说这事的时候
items.quote: - We are, but there's... - Stef, this is not the time, all right?

items.meaning: 申请驳回案件的动议；法律
items.quote: Miss wexler, I've reviewed your motion to dismiss

items.meaning: 我先打断你一下；阻止继续说
items.quote: - My client was... - Yeah, I'll stop you there.

items.meaning: 反复出现的行为模式
items.quote: which shows pattern of behaviour.

items.meaning: 保持信心、不要灰心
items.quote: Just keep the faith, okay?

items.chunk: I thought you'd be on your way by now.
items.meaning: 我以为你现在该动身了；表达时间预期
items.quote: Rich: I'm confused. I thought you'd be on your way to tucumcari by now.

items.meaning: 亲自参与处理，而非远程指导
items.quote: He wants you there now to straighten this out, hands on.

items.meaning: 完全有能力、绰绰有余
items.quote: The associates are more than capable.

items.meaning: 帮我理解一下；要求解释，可能带质疑
items.quote: Help me understand. It's not like you're in the middle of a murder trial.

items.meaning: 这一点我们能达成共识吗？
items.quote: Can we agree on that?

items.chunk: give a little to get a little
items.meaning: 有所让步才能有所收获
items.quote: Once in a while, you have to give a little to get a little, you know?

items.meaning: 只有好消息；nothing but为只／纯粹
items.quote: I'm nothing but good news for you.

items.chunk: If that's true, things could go well for you.
items.meaning: 如果属实，你的处境可能改善；条件式承诺
items.quote: If that's true, things could go well for you.

items.meaning: 把详情告诉我；deets是details的俚语缩写
items.quote: Give me the deets.

items.meaning: 把钱上交给上级；犯罪组织语境
items.quote: The dealers kick up the cash, right?

items.meaning: 违反某法规或权利；正式
items.quote: And you're in violation of his constitutional rights.

items.meaning: 离开／腾空该场所；正式命令
items.quote: It's time for you two gentlemen to vacate the premises.

items.meaning: 放弃享有某项权利；法律
items.quote: Your client waived his right to an attorney.

items.chunk: whether you like it or not
items.meaning: 不管你愿不愿意
items.quote: - I'm talking whether you like it or not. - You're killing me here, man.

items.meaning: 你真让我头疼／为难；夸张抱怨
items.quote: - I'm talking whether you like it or not. - You're killing me here, man.

items.meaning: 说实话……；口语坦陈
items.quote: And I'm not gonna lie, it hurts.

items.meaning: 耍某人、拿某人开涮
items.quote: I feel like my chain is being jerked,

items.meaning: 结果成功／证实有效
items.quote: And what if what he tells us doesn't pan out?

items.meaning: 又回到起点
items.quote: Oh, well, then he just stays here. I mean, we're back where we started.

items.meaning: 成了被盯上／报复的目标
items.quote: Do you hear what I'm saying? My client is not leaving with a target on his back.

items.meaning: 不追问缘由；无条件提供
items.quote: No questions asked.

items.meaning: 理解、接受某个难以想明白的事
items.quote: That's correct. However, and I know this may be difficult to wrap your head around,

items.meaning: 公平市场价；估价／法律
items.quote: for fair market value plus $5000.

items.meaning: 作为善意的表示
items.quote: So, as a gesture of goodwill,

items.meaning: 逆权占有；长期占有他人土地以取得权利的法律概念
items.quote: Adverse possession means this is my land.

items.meaning: 裁决对某人不利
items.quote: You made that argument in court, and the judge ruled against you.

items.chunk: You don't get to do sth.
items.meaning: 你无权／不能自行做某事；否定资格
items.quote: You do not get to make up your own rules.

items.meaning: 醒悟、恢复理智
items.quote: Tomorrow you come to your senses? You'll get 10.

items.meaning: 把事情拖延很久
items.quote: Why should you get to drag this out for seven months while all of your neighbours, every single one of them, played by the rules?

items.meaning: 接受现实吧；尖锐回应
items.quote: Deal with it.

items.meaning: 美妙／令人欣赏的东西
items.quote: It's a fine vehicle. That's a thing of beauty.

items.meaning: 猛烈地、异常积极地
items.quote: There's a pair of them, and they're into this with a vengeance.

items.meaning: 一心争取某目标；这里指要抓人
items.quote: And, um, they're gunning for arrests.

items.chunk: be in the middle of it
items.meaning: 卷进这件事／处在冲突中间；不同于既有be in the middle of sth.正在忙某事
items.quote: I mean, if there's gonna be blowback, I don't want to be in the middle of it.

items.meaning: 联系上某人
items.quote: and ask how I can get in touch with him before his hearing.

items.meaning: 请一天假／歇一天
items.quote: I can take off any day this week, and I'll pay for it out of my own pocket.

items.meaning: 我不能假装理解……；承认理解的限度
items.quote: You're right. I can't pretend to understand what you're going through.

items.meaning: 始终比某人先一步
items.quote: She was always one step ahead of the landlord.
